summary.en: Maintained by the ShyPie project. The Magpie-side gate of ShyPie's privacy-first workflow for DeepSeek Harness: with DSH on DeepSeek models behind Magpie's gateway, it turns away image/file/audio parts, encoded blobs and models outside the allowlist whenever Magpie cannot mask them locally. It does not mask text (Magpie's Privacy masking does); images and files get a 403 by default unless localModels and localProviders both allow them. Set binaryPolicy: guide to withhold binary parts and ask the model to choose a local extraction tool instead; structural checks fail closed; a request above maxNodes values is refused, but text beyond scanChars is not inspected (newest first, each field capped), so long encoded tokens can be false positives. Per-agent page/panel/action controls: every agent is protected by default; disabledAgents (ids or globs) bypass the gate explicitly, disabled custom ids remain visible, raw policy patterns are preserved, and options save merges into freshly read options.
summary.zh: 由 ShyPie 项目维护。ShyPie 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的隐私优先工作流中 Magpie 一侧的出口门：当 DSH 通过 Magpie 网关使用 DeepSeek 模型时，对 Magpie 无法本地掩码的图片/文件/音频、编码数据块和允许列表之外的模型一律拒绝。它不做文本掩码（文本由 Magpie Privacy 负责）；图片和文件默认返回 403，除非 localModels 和 localProviders 都允许。设置 binaryPolicy: guide 可暂扣二进制内容并提示模型选择本地提取工具；结构性检查按失败关闭处理；超过 maxNodes 个值的请求会被拒绝，但超过 scanChars 的文本不会被检查（优先扫描最新内容，每个字段有上限），较长的编码串可能被误判。 按 Agent 的页面/面板/操作菜单：默认保护所有 Agent；disabledAgents（ID 或 glob）显式绕过防护，已禁用的自定义 ID 仍可见，原始策略模式会保留，保存时会合并最新读取的配置。
